# Vendored Dependencies

`raylib/src/` and `raylib/LICENSE` are unmodified files from upstream raylib tag
`6.0`: https://github.com/raysan5/raylib/tree/6.0 . The source is checked in so
builds never require a sibling repository or a raylib download.

Source archive: `https://codeload.github.com/raysan5/raylib/zip/refs/tags/6.0`

SHA-256: `a6770924fed7b25de9f6009ec236cd095a99577a3907026da2bfa21a27ad271a`

Raylib and its bundled dependencies retain their upstream license notices.
The initial Windows build uses GLFW/OpenGL; fast gameplay tests do not link raylib.
